recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: off-grid mesh radios knitting hills without a tower in sight
download mirrors wearing a familiar face until they bite
an economy sliding up the league table while nobody is watching
health tracers drawing a ship's path through ports like connect-the-dots
may fog padding the bay, eleven degrees and the cliffs gone soft

composer-2-fast.concept: You are a pulse riding three fog lanes; only certain lanes open on the stutter beat—swap lanes to slip through closing gates before the bar loops.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Left/right lane swap timed to alternating beat windows (2-and-4 stutter gates).
composer-2-fast.touch_control: Swipe left or right to change lanes; optional double-tap to hop a lane.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: One loop is ~45s: clear the phrase without clipping a closed gate, combo streak lights the fog.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Gates shrink, ghost lanes flash false openings, tempo inches up each loop.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Neon fog corridor, kick drums as floor stripes, pink mist

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Wake a dormant feed of blank nodes by drawing one unbroken wire through a hex grid—each vertex powers a pixel that reveals a micro headline glyph.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Single-stroke path drawing through all required nodes without crossing dead cells.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: Drag finger to trace; lift to confirm or backtrack one step.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Three puzzles pack into a minute; each solved panel adds a new color layer to the sky.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Dead cells multiply, forced visit order appears, timer paints the fog inward.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: Paper UI, ink trails, spring green and slate like a morning dashboard

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: A dew-speck bonsai sits in wind; flick droplets onto branches to grow buds—wrong angle and petals shear off, right angle stacks blossom multiplier.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Angled flick targeting with arc preview; collect drifting petals for score, avoid brown rot spots.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: Flick in the direction you want droplets to fly; hold short for power meter.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: One tree, escalating gust bands; satisfying when a triple-bloom chain clears the screen.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Wind shear tilts arcs, rot patches crawl along bark, petals demands precision flicks.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Watercolor bonsai, cream fog, dream-pop pastel bloom flares

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: A ring of colored orbs pulses like a verse; memorize the flash order, then tap backwards for bonus stutter—forward only clears the round.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Simon-style sequence with reverse rounds and occasional double-flashes (stutter beats).
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: Tap orbs on the ring in order; long-press center to enter reverse mode.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Each perfect reverse doubles a neon pulse across the ring for 30-50s bursts.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Sequences lengthen, stutter ghosts appear, palette inverts mid-round.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: Chrome ring in fog, holographic genre-colored orbs, Scandinavian minimal chrome
